def scatter_mean(src, index, dim_size):
    """Scatter mean: average src values by index."""
    out = torch.zeros(dim_size, src.size(-1), device=src.device)
    count = torch.zeros(dim_size, 1, device=src.device)
    out.index_add_(0, index, src)
    count.index_add_(0, index, torch.ones(src.size(0), 1, device=src.device))
    return out / count.clamp(min=1)

class GatedIntraConv(nn.Module):
    """Edge-gated intra-molecular convolution with residual."""
    def __init__(self, H, edge_dim, drop=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.edge_gate = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(edge_dim, H), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.msg = nn.Linear(H, H)
        self.upd = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(H, H), nn.BatchNorm1d(H), nn.LeakyReLU(), nn.Dropout(drop))

    def forward(self, x, edge_index, edge_attr):
        src, dst = edge_index
        msg = self.msg(x[src]) * self.edge_gate(edge_attr)
        agg = torch.zeros_like(x)
        agg.index_add_(0, dst, msg)
        return self.upd(x + agg)


class EdgeAttnInterConv(nn.Module):
    """Cross-attention inter-molecular conv with edge-conditioned attention bias."""
    def __init__(self, H, edge_dim, drop=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.q = nn.Linear(H, H); self.k = nn.Linear(H, H); self.v = nn.Linear(H, H)
        self.edge_bias = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(edge_dim, H // 4), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H // 4, 1))
        self.out = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(H, H), nn.Dropout(drop))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(H)

    def forward(self, x_src, x_dst, edge_index, edge_attr, num_dst):
        src, dst = edge_index
        q, k, v = self.q(x_dst[dst]), self.k(x_src[src]), self.v(x_src[src])
        attn = (q * k).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / math.sqrt(q.size(-1)) + self.edge_bias(edge_attr)
        mx = torch.zeros(num_dst, 1, device=attn.device).fill_(-1e9)
        mx.index_reduce_(0, dst, attn, 'amax', include_self=True)
        e = torch.exp(attn - mx[dst])
        s = torch.zeros(num_dst, 1, device=attn.device)
        s.index_add_(0, dst, e)
        agg = torch.zeros(num_dst, v.size(-1), device=v.device)
        agg.index_add_(0, dst, v * e / s[dst].clamp(min=1e-8))
        return self.norm(x_dst + self.out(agg))


def _edge_softmax(scores, batch_idx, num_graphs):
    mx = torch.zeros(num_graphs, 1, device=scores.device).fill_(-1e9)
    mx.index_reduce_(0, batch_idx, scores, 'amax', include_self=True)
    e = torch.exp(scores - mx[batch_idx])
    s = torch.zeros(num_graphs, 1, device=scores.device)
    s.index_add_(0, batch_idx, e)
    return e / s[batch_idx].clamp(min=1e-8)


class AffinityModel(nn.Module):
    """GHIA: Gated Heterogeneous Interaction with Adaptive fusion.
    Novel: (1) edge-gated intra conv, (2) edge-conditioned cross-attention inter,
    (3) adaptive gated fusion, (4) lightweight bias correction, (5) dual 3-term loss."""
    def __init__(self, lig_dim, poc_dim, intra_edge_dim, inter_edge_dim):
        super().__init__()
        H = 256; self.NL = 3
        self.lin_l = nn.Linear(lig_dim, H); self.lin_p = nn.Linear(poc_dim, H)
        self.lin_el = nn.Linear(intra_edge_dim, H); self.lin_ep = nn.Linear(intra_edge_dim, H)
        self.intra_l = nn.ModuleList([GatedIntraConv(H, H) for _ in range(self.NL)])
        self.intra_p = nn.ModuleList([GatedIntraConv(H, H) for _ in range(self.NL)])
        self.inter_lp = nn.ModuleList([EdgeAttnInterConv(H, inter_edge_dim) for _ in range(self.NL)])
        self.inter_pl = nn.ModuleList([EdgeAttnInterConv(H, inter_edge_dim) for _ in range(self.NL)])
        self.gate_l = nn.ModuleList([nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * H, H), nn.Sigmoid()) for _ in range(self.NL)])
        self.gate_p = nn.ModuleList([nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * H, H), nn.Sigmoid()) for _ in range(self.NL)])
        # Dual scoring heads
        self.prj_lp_s = nn.Linear(H, H); self.prj_lp_d = nn.Linear(H, H)
        self.prj_lp_e = nn.Linear(inter_edge_dim, H); self.fc_lp = nn.Linear(H, 1)
        self.prj_pl_s = nn.Linear(H, H); self.prj_pl_d = nn.Linear(H, H)
        self.prj_pl_e = nn.Linear(inter_edge_dim, H); self.fc_pl = nn.Linear(H, 1)
        # Lightweight attention bias correction (shared architecture for L->P and P->L)
        self.bc_lp_att = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(H * 2 + inter_edge_dim, H), nn.PReLU(), nn.Linear(H, 1))
        self.bc_lp_val = nn.Linear(H * 2 + inter_edge_dim, H)
        self.bc_lp_out = nn.Linear(H, 1)
        self.bc_pl_att = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(H * 2 + inter_edge_dim, H), nn.PReLU(), nn.Linear(H, 1))
        self.bc_pl_val = nn.Linear(H * 2 + inter_edge_dim, H)
        self.bc_pl_out = nn.Linear(H, 1)
        # Graph-level context
        self.ctx = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * H, H), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(H, 1))

    def _dual_heads(self, batch):
        B = batch.labels.size(0)
        lig_h, poc_h = self.lin_l(batch.lig_x), self.lin_p(batch.poc_x)
        lig_e, poc_e = self.lin_el(batch.lig_edge_attr), self.lin_ep(batch.poc_edge_attr)
        for i in range(self.NL):
            li = self.intra_l[i](lig_h, batch.lig_edge_index, lig_e)
            pi = self.intra_p[i](poc_h, batch.poc_edge_index, poc_e)
            lx, px = lig_h, poc_h
            if batch.l2p_edge_index.size(1) > 0:
                px = self.inter_lp[i](lig_h, poc_h, batch.l2p_edge_index, batch.l2p_edge_attr, poc_h.size(0))
            if batch.p2l_edge_index.size(1) > 0:
                lx = self.inter_pl[i](poc_h, lig_h, batch.p2l_edge_index, batch.p2l_edge_attr, lig_h.size(0))
            gl = self.gate_l[i](torch.cat([li, lx], -1))
            gp = self.gate_p[i](torch.cat([pi, px], -1))
            lig_h = gl * li + (1 - gl) * lx
            poc_h = gp * pi + (1 - gp) * px
        # L->P scoring
        l2p_s, l2p_d = batch.l2p_edge_index
        i_lp = self.prj_lp_e(batch.l2p_edge_attr) * self.prj_lp_s(lig_h)[l2p_s] * self.prj_lp_d(poc_h)[l2p_d]
        pred_lp = torch.zeros(B, 1, device=i_lp.device)
        pred_lp.index_add_(0, batch.inter_batch, self.fc_lp(i_lp))
        # P->L scoring
        p2l_s, p2l_d = batch.p2l_edge_index; p2l_b = batch.lig_batch[p2l_d]
        i_pl = self.prj_pl_e(batch.p2l_edge_attr) * self.prj_pl_s(poc_h)[p2l_s] * self.prj_pl_d(lig_h)[p2l_d]
        pred_pl = torch.zeros(B, 1, device=i_pl.device)
        pred_pl.index_add_(0, p2l_b, self.fc_pl(i_pl))
        # Bias correction L->P
        feat_lp = torch.cat([lig_h[l2p_s], poc_h[l2p_d], batch.l2p_edge_attr], -1)
        a_lp = _edge_softmax(self.bc_lp_att(feat_lp), batch.inter_batch, B)
        v_lp = F.leaky_relu(self.bc_lp_val(feat_lp))
        agg_lp = torch.zeros(B, v_lp.size(-1), device=v_lp.device)
        agg_lp.index_add_(0, batch.inter_batch, a_lp * v_lp)
        bias_lp = self.bc_lp_out(agg_lp)
        # Bias correction P->L
        feat_pl = torch.cat([poc_h[p2l_s], lig_h[p2l_d], batch.p2l_edge_attr], -1)
        a_pl = _edge_softmax(self.bc_pl_att(feat_pl), p2l_b, B)
        v_pl = F.leaky_relu(self.bc_pl_val(feat_pl))
        agg_pl = torch.zeros(B, v_pl.size(-1), device=v_pl.device)
        agg_pl.index_add_(0, p2l_b, a_pl * v_pl)
        bias_pl = self.bc_pl_out(agg_pl)
        # Graph context
        lp = scatter_mean(lig_h, batch.lig_batch, B)
        pp = scatter_mean(poc_h, batch.poc_batch, B)
        ctx = self.ctx(torch.cat([lp, pp], -1))
        return (pred_lp - bias_lp + ctx).squeeze(-1), (pred_pl - bias_pl + ctx).squeeze(-1)

    def forward(self, batch):
        p1, p2 = self._dual_heads(batch)
        return (p1 + p2) / 2

    def compute_loss(self, batch, labels):
        p1, p2 = self._dual_heads(batch)
        return (F.mse_loss(p1, labels) + F.mse_loss(p2, labels) + F.mse_loss(p1, p2)) / 3

class PLADataset(Dataset):
    """Dataset for protein-ligand binding affinity prediction.
    Loads pre-converted .pt files containing graph tensors.
    """

    def __init__(self, data_path):
        self.data = torch.load(data_path, weights_only=False)
        print(f"Loaded {len(self.data)} complexes from {data_path}")

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.data)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.data[idx]


def collate_pla(batch_list):
    """Collate variable-size protein-ligand complexes into PLABatch."""
    lig_x_list, lig_ei_list, lig_ea_list, lig_batch_list = [], [], [], []
    poc_x_list, poc_ei_list, poc_ea_list, poc_batch_list = [], [], [], []
    l2p_ei_list, l2p_ea_list, p2l_ei_list, p2l_ea_list = [], [], [], []
    inter_batch_list = []
    labels_list = []
    num_lig_list, num_poc_list = [], []

    lig_offset = 0
    poc_offset = 0

    for i, item in enumerate(batch_list):
        n_lig = item['num_lig_atoms']
        n_poc = item['num_poc_atoms']

        lig_x_list.append(item['lig_x'])
        lig_batch_list.append(torch.full((n_lig,), i, dtype=torch.long))

        poc_x_list.append(item['poc_x'])
        poc_batch_list.append(torch.full((n_poc,), i, dtype=torch.long))

        # Offset edge indices
        if item['lig_edge_index'].size(1) > 0:
            lig_ei_list.append(item['lig_edge_index'] + lig_offset)
            lig_ea_list.append(item['lig_edge_attr'])

        if item['poc_edge_index'].size(1) > 0:
            poc_ei_list.append(item['poc_edge_index'] + poc_offset)
            poc_ea_list.append(item['poc_edge_attr'])

        # Inter-molecular edges: src from ligand, dst from pocket (l2p)
        if item['l2p_edge_index'].size(1) > 0:
            l2p_ei = item['l2p_edge_index'].clone()
            l2p_ei[0] += lig_offset  # ligand source
            l2p_ei[1] += poc_offset  # pocket dest
            l2p_ei_list.append(l2p_ei)
            l2p_ea_list.append(item['l2p_edge_attr'])
            inter_batch_list.append(torch.full((l2p_ei.size(1),), i, dtype=torch.long))

        # Inter-molecular edges: src from pocket, dst from ligand (p2l)
        if item['p2l_edge_index'].size(1) > 0:
            p2l_ei = item['p2l_edge_index'].clone()
            p2l_ei[0] += poc_offset  # pocket source
            p2l_ei[1] += lig_offset  # ligand dest
            p2l_ei_list.append(p2l_ei)
            p2l_ea_list.append(item['p2l_edge_attr'])

        labels_list.append(item['label'])
        num_lig_list.append(n_lig)
        num_poc_list.append(n_poc)

        lig_offset += n_lig
        poc_offset += n_poc

    # Concatenate
    lig_x = torch.cat(lig_x_list, dim=0)
    lig_batch = torch.cat(lig_batch_list, dim=0)
    poc_x = torch.cat(poc_x_list, dim=0)
    poc_batch = torch.cat(poc_batch_list, dim=0)

    lig_edge_index = torch.cat(lig_ei_list, dim=1) if lig_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    lig_edge_attr = torch.cat(lig_ea_list, dim=0) if lig_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTRA_EDGE_DIM)
    poc_edge_index = torch.cat(poc_ei_list, dim=1) if poc_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    poc_edge_attr = torch.cat(poc_ea_list, dim=0) if poc_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTRA_EDGE_DIM)

    l2p_edge_index = torch.cat(l2p_ei_list, dim=1) if l2p_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    l2p_edge_attr = torch.cat(l2p_ea_list, dim=0) if l2p_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTER_EDGE_DIM)
    p2l_edge_index = torch.cat(p2l_ei_list, dim=1) if p2l_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    p2l_edge_attr = torch.cat(p2l_ea_list, dim=0) if p2l_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTER_EDGE_DIM)
    inter_batch = torch.cat(inter_batch_list, dim=0) if inter_batch_list else torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.long)

    labels = torch.cat(labels_list, dim=0)

    return PLABatch(
        lig_x=lig_x, lig_edge_index=lig_edge_index, lig_edge_attr=lig_edge_attr, lig_batch=lig_batch,
        poc_x=poc_x, poc_edge_index=poc_edge_index, poc_edge_attr=poc_edge_attr, poc_batch=poc_batch,
        l2p_edge_index=l2p_edge_index, l2p_edge_attr=l2p_edge_attr,
        p2l_edge_index=p2l_edge_index, p2l_edge_attr=p2l_edge_attr,
        num_lig_atoms=num_lig_list, num_poc_atoms=num_poc_list,
        inter_batch=inter_batch,
        labels=labels,
    )


def batch_to_device(batch, device):
    return PLABatch(
        lig_x=batch.lig_x.to(device),
        lig_edge_index=batch.lig_edge_index.to(device),
        lig_edge_attr=batch.lig_edge_attr.to(device),
        lig_batch=batch.lig_batch.to(device),
        poc_x=batch.poc_x.to(device),
        poc_edge_index=batch.poc_edge_index.to(device),
        poc_edge_attr=batch.poc_edge_attr.to(device),
        poc_batch=batch.poc_batch.to(device),
        l2p_edge_index=batch.l2p_edge_index.to(device),
        l2p_edge_attr=batch.l2p_edge_attr.to(device),
        p2l_edge_index=batch.p2l_edge_index.to(device),
        p2l_edge_attr=batch.p2l_edge_attr.to(device),
        num_lig_atoms=batch.num_lig_atoms,
        num_poc_atoms=batch.num_poc_atoms,
        inter_batch=batch.inter_batch.to(device),
        labels=batch.labels.to(device),
    )

def train_epoch(model, loader, optimizer, device):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_batches = 0

    for batch in loader:
        batch = batch_to_device(batch, device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()

        # Models with custom multi-head losses (e.g. EHIGN's 3-term dual-head loss)
        # can expose `compute_loss(batch, labels)` returning a scalar loss directly.
        # Single-head models fall back to plain MSE on forward() output.
        if hasattr(model, 'compute_loss'):
            loss = model.compute_loss(batch, batch.labels)
        else:
            pred = model(batch)
            loss = F.mse_loss(pred, batch.labels)

        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

        total_loss += loss.item()
        n_batches += 1

    return total_loss / max(n_batches, 1)


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []

    for batch in loader:
        batch = batch_to_device(batch, device)
        pred = model(batch)
        all_preds.append(pred.cpu().numpy())
        all_labels.append(batch.labels.cpu().numpy())

    preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)

    rmse = float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(labels, preds)))
    rp = float(pearsonr(preds, labels)[0])

    return rmse, rp


def train_and_evaluate(args):
    device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
    print(f"Using device: {device}")

    # Load data
    data_dir = args.data_dir
    train_ds = PLADataset(os.path.join(data_dir, 'train_data.pt'))
    valid_ds = PLADataset(os.path.join(data_dir, 'valid_data.pt'))
    test_ds = PLADataset(os.path.join(data_dir, f'{args.test_set}_data.pt'))

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=True,
                              collate_fn=collate_pla, num_workers=4, drop_last=True)
    valid_loader = DataLoader(valid_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=False,
                              collate_fn=collate_pla, num_workers=4)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=False,
                             collate_fn=collate_pla, num_workers=4)

    print(f"Train: {len(train_ds)}, Valid: {len(valid_ds)}, Test ({args.test_set}): {len(test_ds)}")

    # Model
    model = AffinityModel(
        lig_dim=LIGAND_ATOM_DIM,
        poc_dim=POCKET_ATOM_DIM,
        intra_edge_dim=INTRA_EDGE_DIM,
        inter_edge_dim=INTER_EDGE_DIM,
    ).to(device)
    print(f"Model parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")

    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=args.lr, weight_decay=1e-6)

    # Training with early stopping
    best_val_rmse = float('inf')
    best_epoch = 0
    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(1, args.epochs + 1):
        train_loss = train_epoch(model, train_loader, optimizer, device)
        val_rmse, val_rp = evaluate(model, valid_loader, device)

        print(f"TRAIN_METRICS epoch={epoch} loss={train_loss:.6f} val_rmse={val_rmse:.4f} val_rp={val_rp:.4f}")

        if val_rmse < best_val_rmse:
            best_val_rmse = val_rmse
            best_epoch = epoch
            patience_counter = 0
            os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), os.path.join(args.output_dir, 'best_model.pt'))
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= args.patience:
                print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch}. Best epoch: {best_epoch}")
                break

    # Load best model and evaluate on test set
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(os.path.join(args.output_dir, 'best_model.pt'), weights_only=True))
    test_rmse, test_rp = evaluate(model, test_loader, device)
    print(f"TEST_METRICS rmse={test_rmse:.6f} rp={test_rp:.6f}")
    print(f"Best val RMSE: {best_val_rmse:.4f} at epoch {best_epoch}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction")
    parser.add_argument('--test-set', type=str, required=True,
                        choices=['test2013', 'test2016', 'test2019'])

    # Set seeds

class GeoGATConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, node_dim, edge_dim, hidden_dim, heads=4, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.heads = heads
        self.hidden_dim = hidden_dim
        self.head_dim = hidden_dim // heads
        
        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(node_dim, hidden_dim, bias=False)
        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(node_dim, hidden_dim, bias=False)
        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(node_dim, hidden_dim, bias=False)
        
        self.e_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(edge_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
        )
        self.e_bias = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, heads)
        
        self.out_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        
    def forward(self, x_src, x_dst, edge_index, edge_attr, num_dst):
        src, dst = edge_index
        if src.size(0) == 0:
            return torch.zeros(num_dst, self.hidden_dim, device=x_dst.device)
            
        q = self.q_proj(x_dst).view(-1, self.heads, self.head_dim)
        k = self.k_proj(x_src).view(-1, self.heads, self.head_dim)
        v = self.v_proj(x_src).view(-1, self.heads, self.head_dim)
        
        e = self.e_proj(edge_attr)
        e_bias = self.e_bias(e)
        e_v = e.view(-1, self.heads, self.head_dim)
        
        alpha = (q[dst] * k[src]).sum(dim=-1) / math.sqrt(self.head_dim) + e_bias
        
        max_alpha = torch.zeros(num_dst, self.heads, device=alpha.device).fill_(-1e9)
        max_alpha.index_reduce_(0, dst, alpha, 'amax', include_self=True)
        exp_alpha = torch.exp(alpha - max_alpha[dst])
        
        sum_exp = torch.zeros(num_dst, self.heads, device=alpha.device)
        sum_exp.index_add_(0, dst, exp_alpha)
        
        alpha_norm = exp_alpha / sum_exp[dst].clamp(min=1e-8)
        
        msg = (v[src] + e_v) * alpha_norm.unsqueeze(-1)
        msg = msg.view(-1, self.hidden_dim)
        
        agg = torch.zeros(num_dst, self.hidden_dim, device=msg.device)
        agg.index_add_(0, dst, msg)
        
        return self.out_proj(agg)


class AffinityModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, lig_dim, poc_dim, intra_edge_dim, inter_edge_dim):
        super().__init__()
        H = 256
        num_layers = 4
        heads = 4
        dropout = 0.1
        
        self.lig_embed = nn.Linear(lig_dim, H)
        self.poc_embed = nn.Linear(poc_dim, H)
        
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList()

            self.layers.append(nn.ModuleDict({
                'norm_l': nn.LayerNorm(H),
                'norm_p': nn.LayerNorm(H),
                'intra_l': GeoGATConv(H, intra_edge_dim, H, heads, dropout),
                'intra_p': GeoGATConv(H, intra_edge_dim, H, heads, dropout),
                'inter_lp': GeoGATConv(H, inter_edge_dim, H, heads, dropout),
                'inter_pl': GeoGATConv(H, inter_edge_dim, H, heads, dropout),
                'update_l': nn.Sequential(
                    nn.LayerNorm(H),
                    nn.Linear(H, H * 2),
                    nn.SiLU(),
                    nn.Dropout(dropout),
                    nn.Linear(H * 2, H),
                    nn.Dropout(dropout)
                ),
                'update_p': nn.Sequential(
                    nn.LayerNorm(H),
                    nn.Linear(H, H * 2),
                    nn.SiLU(),
                    nn.Dropout(dropout),
                    nn.Linear(H * 2, H),
                    nn.Dropout(dropout)

            }))
            
        self.prj_lp_src = nn.Linear(H, H)
        self.prj_lp_dst = nn.Linear(H, H)
        self.prj_lp_edge = nn.Linear(inter_edge_dim, H)

        self.prj_pl_dst = nn.Linear(H, H)
        self.prj_pl_edge = nn.Linear(inter_edge_dim, H)

            nn.Linear(H * 2, H),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(H, 1)
        )

    def _forward_heads(self, batch: PLABatch):
        B = batch.labels.size(0)
        lig_h = self.lig_embed(batch.lig_x)
        poc_h = self.poc_embed(batch.poc_x)
        
        for layer in self.layers:
            lig_norm = layer['norm_l'](lig_h)
            poc_norm = layer['norm_p'](poc_h)
            
            lig_intra = layer['intra_l'](lig_norm, lig_norm, batch.lig_edge_index, batch.lig_edge_attr, lig_h.size(0))
            poc_intra = layer['intra_p'](poc_norm, poc_norm, batch.poc_edge_index, batch.poc_edge_attr, poc_h.size(0))
            
            lig_inter = torch.zeros_like(lig_h)
            poc_inter = torch.zeros_like(poc_h)
            if batch.l2p_edge_index.size(1) > 0:
                poc_inter = layer['inter_lp'](lig_norm, poc_norm, batch.l2p_edge_index, batch.l2p_edge_attr, poc_h.size(0))

            poc_h = poc_h + poc_intra + poc_inter
            
            lig_h = lig_h + layer['update_l'](lig_h)
            poc_h = poc_h + layer['update_p'](poc_h)
            
        pred_lp = torch.zeros(B, 1, device=lig_h.device)
        if batch.l2p_edge_index.size(1) > 0:
            l2p_src, l2p_dst = batch.l2p_edge_index
            i_lp = self.prj_lp_edge(batch.l2p_edge_attr) * self.prj_lp_src(lig_h)[l2p_src] * self.prj_lp_dst(poc_h)[l2p_dst]
            logit_lp = self.fc_lp(F.silu(i_lp))
            pred_lp.index_add_(0, batch.inter_batch, logit_lp)
            
        pred_pl = torch.zeros(B, 1, device=lig_h.device)
        if batch.p2l_edge_index.size(1) > 0:
            p2l_src, p2l_dst = batch.p2l_edge_index
            p2l_batch = batch.lig_batch[p2l_dst]
            i_pl = self.prj_pl_edge(batch.p2l_edge_attr) * self.prj_pl_src(poc_h)[p2l_src] * self.prj_pl_dst(lig_h)[p2l_dst]
            logit_pl = self.fc_pl(F.silu(i_pl))
            pred_pl.index_add_(0, p2l_batch, logit_pl)
            
        lig_pool = scatter_mean(lig_h, batch.lig_batch, B)
        poc_pool = scatter_mean(poc_h, batch.poc_batch, B)
        global_pred = self.global_readout(torch.cat([lig_pool, poc_pool], dim=-1))
        
        pred_lp = pred_lp + global_pred
        pred_pl = pred_pl + global_pred
        
        return pred_lp.squeeze(-1), pred_pl.squeeze(-1)

    def forward(self, batch: PLABatch) -> torch.Tensor:
        pred_lp, pred_pl = self._forward_heads(batch)
        return (pred_lp + pred_pl) / 2

    def compute_loss(self, batch: PLABatch, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        pred_lp, pred_pl = self._forward_heads(batch)
        loss = (F.mse_loss(pred_lp, labels)
                + F.mse_loss(pred_pl, labels)
                + F.mse_loss(pred_lp, pred_pl)) / 3
        return loss

            p2l_ea_list.append(item['p2l_edge_attr'])

        num_poc_list.append(n_poc)

        poc_offset += n_poc

def train_epoch(model, loader, optimizer, device):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_batches = 0

        batch = batch_to_device(batch, device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()

        # Models with custom multi-head losses (e.g. EHIGN's 3-term dual-head loss)
        # can expose `compute_loss(batch, labels)` returning a scalar loss directly.
        # Single-head models fall back to plain MSE on forward() output.

        else:
            pred = model(batch)
            loss = F.mse_loss(pred, batch.labels)

        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

        total_loss += loss.item()
        n_batches += 1

    return total_loss / max(n_batches, 1)

    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []

        all_preds.append(pred.cpu().numpy())
        all_labels.append(batch.labels.cpu().numpy())

    labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)

@dataclass
class PLABatch:
    """Batched protein-ligand complex data for binding affinity prediction.

    All graphs in the batch are merged into single tensors with offset indices.
    """
    # Ligand graph
    lig_x: torch.Tensor              # [total_lig_atoms, 35]
    lig_edge_index: torch.Tensor     # [2, total_lig_edges]
    lig_edge_attr: torch.Tensor      # [total_lig_edges, 17]
    lig_batch: torch.Tensor          # [total_lig_atoms] graph assignment

    # Pocket graph
    poc_x: torch.Tensor              # [total_poc_atoms, 35]
    poc_edge_index: torch.Tensor     # [2, total_poc_edges]
    poc_edge_attr: torch.Tensor      # [total_poc_edges, 17]
    poc_batch: torch.Tensor          # [total_poc_atoms] graph assignment

    # Inter-molecular edges (ligand -> pocket)
    l2p_edge_index: torch.Tensor     # [2, total_l2p_edges] (src=lig, dst=poc)
    l2p_edge_attr: torch.Tensor      # [total_l2p_edges, 11]

    # Inter-molecular edges (pocket -> ligand)
    p2l_edge_index: torch.Tensor     # [2, total_p2l_edges] (src=poc, dst=lig)
    p2l_edge_attr: torch.Tensor      # [total_p2l_edges, 11]

    # Metadata
    num_lig_atoms: List[int]         # per-complex ligand atom counts
    num_poc_atoms: List[int]         # per-complex pocket atom counts
    inter_batch: torch.Tensor        # [total_l2p_edges] graph assignment for inter edges

    # Target
    labels: torch.Tensor             # [B]

def scatter_mean(src, index, dim_size):
    """Scatter mean: average src values by index."""
    out = torch.zeros(dim_size, src.size(-1), device=src.device)
    count = torch.zeros(dim_size, 1, device=src.device)
    out.index_add_(0, index, src)
    count.index_add_(0, index, torch.ones(src.size(0), 1, device=src.device))
    return out / count.clamp(min=1)

class TriGateConv(nn.Module):
    """Bidirectional edge-gated message passing with degree-normalized residual mixing.

    Novelty: messages are modulated by a tri-linear gate involving source node,
    destination node, and edge geometry. This lets the model upweight contacts
    only when source chemistry, destination environment, and edge geometry agree.
    """

    def __init__(self, src_dim, dst_dim, edge_dim, hidden_dim, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.src_proj = nn.Linear(src_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.dst_proj = nn.Linear(dst_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.edge_proj = nn.Linear(edge_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.msg_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(src_dim + edge_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )
        self.out_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(dst_dim + hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
        )
        self.mix = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.0))

    def forward(self, x_src, x_dst, edge_index, edge_attr, num_dst):
        if edge_index.size(1) == 0:
            return self.out_mlp(torch.cat([x_dst, torch.zeros(num_dst, self.src_proj.out_features, device=x_dst.device)], dim=-1))
        src, dst = edge_index
        gate = torch.sigmoid(self.src_proj(x_src)[src] + self.dst_proj(x_dst)[dst] + self.edge_proj(edge_attr))
        raw_msg = self.msg_mlp(torch.cat([x_src[src], edge_attr], dim=-1))
        msg = gate * raw_msg
        agg = torch.zeros(num_dst, msg.size(-1), device=msg.device)
        deg = torch.zeros(num_dst, 1, device=msg.device)
        agg.index_add_(0, dst, msg)
        deg.index_add_(0, dst, torch.ones(msg.size(0), 1, device=msg.device))
        agg = agg / deg.clamp(min=1.0).sqrt()
        update = self.out_mlp(torch.cat([x_dst, agg], dim=-1))
        alpha = torch.sigmoid(self.mix)
        return alpha * x_dst + (1 - alpha) * update


class AffinityModel(nn.Module):
    """Cross-gated dual-view affinity predictor.

    Algorithmic contribution:
    1) TriGateConv uses source-destination-edge multiplicative gating.
    2) Inter-edge attentive statistics pool both mean and softmax-weighted
       interaction moments.
    3) Dual directional heads are trained with uncertainty-aware consistency:
       agreement is enforced more strongly when both heads are confident.
    """

    def __init__(self, lig_dim, poc_dim, intra_edge_dim, inter_edge_dim):
        super().__init__()
        H = 192
        L = 3
        self.lig_in = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(lig_dim, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H, H))
        self.poc_in = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(poc_dim, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H, H))
        self.lig_edge = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(intra_edge_dim, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H, intra_edge_dim))
        self.poc_edge = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(intra_edge_dim, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H, intra_edge_dim))
        self.lp_edge = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(inter_edge_dim, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H, inter_edge_dim))
        self.pl_edge = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(inter_edge_dim, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H, inter_edge_dim))

        self.lig_intra = nn.ModuleList([TriGateConv(H, H, intra_edge_dim, H) for _ in range(L)])
        self.poc_intra = nn.ModuleList([TriGateConv(H, H, intra_edge_dim, H) for _ in range(L)])
        self.lp_inter = nn.ModuleList([TriGateConv(H, H, inter_edge_dim, H) for _ in range(L)])
        self.pl_inter = nn.ModuleList([TriGateConv(H, H, inter_edge_dim, H) for _ in range(L)])
        self.norm_l = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(H) for _ in range(L)])
        self.norm_p = nn.ModuleList([nn.LayerNorm(H) for _ in range(L)])

        self.edge_score_lp = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(H * 2 + inter_edge_dim, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H, 1))
        self.edge_score_pl = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(H * 2 + inter_edge_dim, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H, 1))
        self.conf_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(H * 4, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H, 2), nn.Softplus())
        self.final_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(H * 8 + 4, H), nn.SiLU(), nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(H, H // 2), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(H // 2, 1)
        )

    def _edge_softmax(self, scores, batch_idx, num_graphs):
        max_scores = torch.full((num_graphs, 1), -1e9, device=scores.device)
        if scores.numel() > 0:
            max_scores.index_reduce_(0, batch_idx, scores, 'amax', include_self=True)
            exp_scores = torch.exp(scores - max_scores[batch_idx])
            denom = torch.zeros(num_graphs, 1, device=scores.device)
            denom.index_add_(0, batch_idx, exp_scores)
            return exp_scores / denom[batch_idx].clamp(min=1e-8)
        return scores

    def _interaction_stats(self, src_h, dst_h, edge_index, edge_attr, edge_batch, B, scorer):
        H = src_h.size(-1)
        if edge_index.size(1) == 0:
            z = torch.zeros(B, H, device=src_h.device)
            return z, z, torch.zeros(B, 1, device=src_h.device)
        src, dst = edge_index
        ef = torch.cat([src_h[src], dst_h[dst], edge_attr], dim=-1)
        logits = scorer(ef)
        att = self._edge_softmax(logits, edge_batch, B)
        pair = src_h[src] * dst_h[dst]
        mean_pair = torch.zeros(B, H, device=src_h.device)
        att_pair = torch.zeros(B, H, device=src_h.device)
        edge_count = torch.zeros(B, 1, device=src_h.device)
        mean_pair.index_add_(0, edge_batch, pair)
        att_pair.index_add_(0, edge_batch, att * pair)
        edge_count.index_add_(0, edge_batch, torch.ones(logits.size(0), 1, device=src_h.device))
        mean_pair = mean_pair / edge_count.clamp(min=1.0)
        score_sum = torch.zeros(B, 1, device=src_h.device)
        score_sum.index_add_(0, edge_batch, logits)
        return mean_pair, att_pair, score_sum

    def _forward_dual(self, batch: PLABatch):
        B = batch.labels.size(0)
        lig_h = self.lig_in(batch.lig_x)
        poc_h = self.poc_in(batch.poc_x)
        lig_e = self.lig_edge(batch.lig_edge_attr)
        poc_e = self.poc_edge(batch.poc_edge_attr)
        lp_e = self.lp_edge(batch.l2p_edge_attr)
        pl_e = self.pl_edge(batch.p2l_edge_attr)

        for i in range(len(self.lig_intra)):
            lig_new = self.lig_intra[i](lig_h, lig_h, batch.lig_edge_index, lig_e, lig_h.size(0))
            poc_new = self.poc_intra[i](poc_h, poc_h, batch.poc_edge_index, poc_e, poc_h.size(0))
            if batch.p2l_edge_index.size(1) > 0:
                lig_new = lig_new + self.pl_inter[i](poc_h, lig_h, batch.p2l_edge_index, pl_e, lig_h.size(0))
            if batch.l2p_edge_index.size(1) > 0:
                poc_new = poc_new + self.lp_inter[i](lig_h, poc_h, batch.l2p_edge_index, lp_e, poc_h.size(0))
            lig_h = self.norm_l[i](lig_h + lig_new)
            poc_h = self.norm_p[i](poc_h + poc_new)

        lig_pool = scatter_mean(lig_h, batch.lig_batch, B)
        poc_pool = scatter_mean(poc_h, batch.poc_batch, B)
        lp_mean, lp_att, lp_sum = self._interaction_stats(lig_h, poc_h, batch.l2p_edge_index, batch.l2p_edge_attr, batch.inter_batch, B, self.edge_score_lp)
        p2l_batch = batch.lig_batch[batch.p2l_edge_index[1]] if batch.p2l_edge_index.size(1) > 0 else torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.long, device=lig_h.device)
        pl_mean, pl_att, pl_sum = self._interaction_stats(poc_h, lig_h, batch.p2l_edge_index, batch.p2l_edge_attr, p2l_batch, B, self.edge_score_pl)

        fused = torch.cat([lig_pool, poc_pool, lp_mean, lp_att, pl_mean, pl_att, lp_sum, pl_sum, lig_pool * poc_pool, torch.abs(lig_pool - poc_pool)], dim=-1)
        pred = self.final_head(fused).squeeze(-1)
        sigma = self.conf_head(torch.cat([lig_pool, poc_pool, lp_att, pl_att], dim=-1)) + 1e-4
        return pred, lp_sum.squeeze(-1), pl_sum.squeeze(-1), sigma[:, 0], sigma[:, 1]

    def forward(self, batch: PLABatch) -> torch.Tensor:
        pred, lp_edge_pred, pl_edge_pred, s1, s2 = self._forward_dual(batch)
        w = torch.softmax(torch.stack([-s1, -s2], dim=-1), dim=-1)
        dual = w[:, 0] * lp_edge_pred + w[:, 1] * pl_edge_pred
        return 0.7 * pred + 0.3 * dual

    def compute_loss(self, batch: PLABatch, labels: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        pred, lp_edge_pred, pl_edge_pred, s1, s2 = self._forward_dual(batch)
        loss_main = F.mse_loss(pred, labels)
        loss_lp = torch.mean(((lp_edge_pred - labels) ** 2) / (2 * s1.clamp(min=1e-4) ** 2) + torch.log(s1))
        loss_pl = torch.mean(((pl_edge_pred - labels) ** 2) / (2 * s2.clamp(min=1e-4) ** 2) + torch.log(s2))
        conf = torch.exp(-(s1.detach() + s2.detach()))
        loss_cons = torch.mean(conf * (lp_edge_pred - pl_edge_pred) ** 2)
        return loss_main + 0.35 * (loss_lp + loss_pl) + 0.15 * loss_cons

class PLADataset(Dataset):
    """Dataset for protein-ligand binding affinity prediction.
    Loads pre-converted .pt files containing graph tensors.
    """

    def __init__(self, data_path):
        self.data = torch.load(data_path, weights_only=False)
        print(f"Loaded {len(self.data)} complexes from {data_path}")

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.data)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.data[idx]


def collate_pla(batch_list):
    """Collate variable-size protein-ligand complexes into PLABatch."""
    lig_x_list, lig_ei_list, lig_ea_list, lig_batch_list = [], [], [], []
    poc_x_list, poc_ei_list, poc_ea_list, poc_batch_list = [], [], [], []
    l2p_ei_list, l2p_ea_list, p2l_ei_list, p2l_ea_list = [], [], [], []
    inter_batch_list = []
    labels_list = []
    num_lig_list, num_poc_list = [], []

    lig_offset = 0
    poc_offset = 0

    for i, item in enumerate(batch_list):
        n_lig = item['num_lig_atoms']
        n_poc = item['num_poc_atoms']

        lig_x_list.append(item['lig_x'])
        lig_batch_list.append(torch.full((n_lig,), i, dtype=torch.long))

        poc_x_list.append(item['poc_x'])
        poc_batch_list.append(torch.full((n_poc,), i, dtype=torch.long))

        # Offset edge indices
        if item['lig_edge_index'].size(1) > 0:
            lig_ei_list.append(item['lig_edge_index'] + lig_offset)
            lig_ea_list.append(item['lig_edge_attr'])

        if item['poc_edge_index'].size(1) > 0:
            poc_ei_list.append(item['poc_edge_index'] + poc_offset)
            poc_ea_list.append(item['poc_edge_attr'])

        # Inter-molecular edges: src from ligand, dst from pocket (l2p)
        if item['l2p_edge_index'].size(1) > 0:
            l2p_ei = item['l2p_edge_index'].clone()
            l2p_ei[0] += lig_offset  # ligand source
            l2p_ei[1] += poc_offset  # pocket dest
            l2p_ei_list.append(l2p_ei)
            l2p_ea_list.append(item['l2p_edge_attr'])
            inter_batch_list.append(torch.full((l2p_ei.size(1),), i, dtype=torch.long))

        # Inter-molecular edges: src from pocket, dst from ligand (p2l)
        if item['p2l_edge_index'].size(1) > 0:
            p2l_ei = item['p2l_edge_index'].clone()
            p2l_ei[0] += poc_offset  # pocket source
            p2l_ei[1] += lig_offset  # ligand dest
            p2l_ei_list.append(p2l_ei)
            p2l_ea_list.append(item['p2l_edge_attr'])

        labels_list.append(item['label'])
        num_lig_list.append(n_lig)
        num_poc_list.append(n_poc)

        lig_offset += n_lig
        poc_offset += n_poc

    # Concatenate
    lig_x = torch.cat(lig_x_list, dim=0)
    lig_batch = torch.cat(lig_batch_list, dim=0)
    poc_x = torch.cat(poc_x_list, dim=0)
    poc_batch = torch.cat(poc_batch_list, dim=0)

    lig_edge_index = torch.cat(lig_ei_list, dim=1) if lig_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    lig_edge_attr = torch.cat(lig_ea_list, dim=0) if lig_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTRA_EDGE_DIM)
    poc_edge_index = torch.cat(poc_ei_list, dim=1) if poc_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    poc_edge_attr = torch.cat(poc_ea_list, dim=0) if poc_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTRA_EDGE_DIM)

    l2p_edge_index = torch.cat(l2p_ei_list, dim=1) if l2p_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    l2p_edge_attr = torch.cat(l2p_ea_list, dim=0) if l2p_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTER_EDGE_DIM)
    p2l_edge_index = torch.cat(p2l_ei_list, dim=1) if p2l_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    p2l_edge_attr = torch.cat(p2l_ea_list, dim=0) if p2l_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTER_EDGE_DIM)
    inter_batch = torch.cat(inter_batch_list, dim=0) if inter_batch_list else torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.long)

    labels = torch.cat(labels_list, dim=0)

    return PLABatch(
        lig_x=lig_x, lig_edge_index=lig_edge_index, lig_edge_attr=lig_edge_attr, lig_batch=lig_batch,
        poc_x=poc_x, poc_edge_index=poc_edge_index, poc_edge_attr=poc_edge_attr, poc_batch=poc_batch,
        l2p_edge_index=l2p_edge_index, l2p_edge_attr=l2p_edge_attr,
        p2l_edge_index=p2l_edge_index, p2l_edge_attr=p2l_edge_attr,
        num_lig_atoms=num_lig_list, num_poc_atoms=num_poc_list,
        inter_batch=inter_batch,
        labels=labels,
    )


def batch_to_device(batch, device):
    return PLABatch(
        lig_x=batch.lig_x.to(device),
        lig_edge_index=batch.lig_edge_index.to(device),
        lig_edge_attr=batch.lig_edge_attr.to(device),
        lig_batch=batch.lig_batch.to(device),
        poc_x=batch.poc_x.to(device),
        poc_edge_index=batch.poc_edge_index.to(device),
        poc_edge_attr=batch.poc_edge_attr.to(device),
        poc_batch=batch.poc_batch.to(device),
        l2p_edge_index=batch.l2p_edge_index.to(device),
        l2p_edge_attr=batch.l2p_edge_attr.to(device),
        p2l_edge_index=batch.p2l_edge_index.to(device),
        p2l_edge_attr=batch.p2l_edge_attr.to(device),
        num_lig_atoms=batch.num_lig_atoms,
        num_poc_atoms=batch.num_poc_atoms,
        inter_batch=batch.inter_batch.to(device),
        labels=batch.labels.to(device),
    )

def train_epoch(model, loader, optimizer, device):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_batches = 0

    for batch in loader:
        batch = batch_to_device(batch, device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()

        # Models with custom multi-head losses (e.g. EHIGN's 3-term dual-head loss)
        # can expose `compute_loss(batch, labels)` returning a scalar loss directly.
        # Single-head models fall back to plain MSE on forward() output.
        if hasattr(model, 'compute_loss'):
            loss = model.compute_loss(batch, batch.labels)
        else:
            pred = model(batch)
            loss = F.mse_loss(pred, batch.labels)

        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

        total_loss += loss.item()
        n_batches += 1

    return total_loss / max(n_batches, 1)


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []

    for batch in loader:
        batch = batch_to_device(batch, device)
        pred = model(batch)
        all_preds.append(pred.cpu().numpy())
        all_labels.append(batch.labels.cpu().numpy())

    preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)

    rmse = float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(labels, preds)))
    rp = float(pearsonr(preds, labels)[0])

    return rmse, rp


def train_and_evaluate(args):
    device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
    print(f"Using device: {device}")

    # Load data
    data_dir = args.data_dir
    train_ds = PLADataset(os.path.join(data_dir, 'train_data.pt'))
    valid_ds = PLADataset(os.path.join(data_dir, 'valid_data.pt'))
    test_ds = PLADataset(os.path.join(data_dir, f'{args.test_set}_data.pt'))

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=True,
                              collate_fn=collate_pla, num_workers=4, drop_last=True)
    valid_loader = DataLoader(valid_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=False,
                              collate_fn=collate_pla, num_workers=4)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=False,
                             collate_fn=collate_pla, num_workers=4)

    print(f"Train: {len(train_ds)}, Valid: {len(valid_ds)}, Test ({args.test_set}): {len(test_ds)}")

    # Model
    model = AffinityModel(
        lig_dim=LIGAND_ATOM_DIM,
        poc_dim=POCKET_ATOM_DIM,
        intra_edge_dim=INTRA_EDGE_DIM,
        inter_edge_dim=INTER_EDGE_DIM,
    ).to(device)
    print(f"Model parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")

    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=args.lr, weight_decay=1e-6)

    # Training with early stopping
    best_val_rmse = float('inf')
    best_epoch = 0
    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(1, args.epochs + 1):
        train_loss = train_epoch(model, train_loader, optimizer, device)
        val_rmse, val_rp = evaluate(model, valid_loader, device)

        print(f"TRAIN_METRICS epoch={epoch} loss={train_loss:.6f} val_rmse={val_rmse:.4f} val_rp={val_rp:.4f}")

        if val_rmse < best_val_rmse:
            best_val_rmse = val_rmse
            best_epoch = epoch
            patience_counter = 0
            os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), os.path.join(args.output_dir, 'best_model.pt'))
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= args.patience:
                print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch}. Best epoch: {best_epoch}")
                break

    # Load best model and evaluate on test set
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(os.path.join(args.output_dir, 'best_model.pt'), weights_only=True))
    test_rmse, test_rp = evaluate(model, test_loader, device)
    print(f"TEST_METRICS rmse={test_rmse:.6f} rp={test_rp:.6f}")
    print(f"Best val RMSE: {best_val_rmse:.4f} at epoch {best_epoch}")


def main():

                        choices=['test2013', 'test2016', 'test2019'])

    lig_edge_index = torch.cat(lig_ei_list, dim=1) if lig_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    lig_edge_attr = torch.cat(lig_ea_list, dim=0) if lig_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTRA_EDGE_DIM)
    poc_edge_index = torch.cat(poc_ei_list, dim=1) if poc_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    poc_edge_attr = torch.cat(poc_ea_list, dim=0) if poc_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTRA_EDGE_DIM)

    l2p_edge_index = torch.cat(l2p_ei_list, dim=1) if l2p_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    l2p_edge_attr = torch.cat(l2p_ea_list, dim=0) if l2p_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTER_EDGE_DIM)
    p2l_edge_index = torch.cat(p2l_ei_list, dim=1) if p2l_ei_list else torch.zeros(2, 0, dtype=torch.long)
    p2l_edge_attr = torch.cat(p2l_ea_list, dim=0) if p2l_ea_list else torch.zeros(0, INTER_EDGE_DIM)
    inter_batch = torch.cat(inter_batch_list, dim=0) if inter_batch_list else torch.zeros(0, dtype=torch.long)

    labels = torch.cat(labels_list, dim=0)

    return PLABatch(
        lig_x=lig_x, lig_edge_index=lig_edge_index, lig_edge_attr=lig_edge_attr, lig_batch=lig_batch,
        poc_x=poc_x, poc_edge_index=poc_edge_index, poc_edge_attr=poc_edge_attr, poc_batch=poc_batch,
        l2p_edge_index=l2p_edge_index, l2p_edge_attr=l2p_edge_attr,
        p2l_edge_index=p2l_edge_index, p2l_edge_attr=p2l_edge_attr,
        num_lig_atoms=num_lig_list, num_poc_atoms=num_poc_list,
        inter_batch=inter_batch,
        labels=labels,
    )


def batch_to_device(batch, device):
    return PLABatch(
        lig_x=batch.lig_x.to(device),
        lig_edge_index=batch.lig_edge_index.to(device),
        lig_edge_attr=batch.lig_edge_attr.to(device),
        lig_batch=batch.lig_batch.to(device),
        poc_x=batch.poc_x.to(device),
        poc_edge_index=batch.poc_edge_index.to(device),
        poc_edge_attr=batch.poc_edge_attr.to(device),
        poc_batch=batch.poc_batch.to(device),
        l2p_edge_index=batch.l2p_edge_index.to(device),
        l2p_edge_attr=batch.l2p_edge_attr.to(device),
        p2l_edge_index=batch.p2l_edge_index.to(device),
        p2l_edge_attr=batch.p2l_edge_attr.to(device),
        num_lig_atoms=batch.num_lig_atoms,
        num_poc_atoms=batch.num_poc_atoms,
        inter_batch=batch.inter_batch.to(device),
        labels=batch.labels.to(device),
    )


# =====================================================================
# Training and evaluation
# =====================================================================

def train_epoch(model, loader, optimizer, device):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_batches = 0

    for batch in loader:
        batch = batch_to_device(batch, device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()

        # Models with custom multi-head losses (e.g. EHIGN's 3-term dual-head loss)
        # can expose `compute_loss(batch, labels)` returning a scalar loss directly.
        # Single-head models fall back to plain MSE on forward() output.
        if hasattr(model, 'compute_loss'):
            loss = model.compute_loss(batch, batch.labels)
        else:
            pred = model(batch)
            loss = F.mse_loss(pred, batch.labels)

        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

        total_loss += loss.item()
        n_batches += 1

    return total_loss / max(n_batches, 1)


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []

    for batch in loader:
        batch = batch_to_device(batch, device)
        pred = model(batch)
        all_preds.append(pred.cpu().numpy())
        all_labels.append(batch.labels.cpu().numpy())

    preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)

    rmse = float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(labels, preds)))
    rp = float(pearsonr(preds, labels)[0])

    return rmse, rp


def train_and_evaluate(args):
    device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
    print(f"Using device: {device}")

    # Load data
    data_dir = args.data_dir
    train_ds = PLADataset(os.path.join(data_dir, 'train_data.pt'))
    valid_ds = PLADataset(os.path.join(data_dir, 'valid_data.pt'))
    test_ds = PLADataset(os.path.join(data_dir, f'{args.test_set}_data.pt'))

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=True,
                              collate_fn=collate_pla, num_workers=4, drop_last=True)
    valid_loader = DataLoader(valid_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=False,
                              collate_fn=collate_pla, num_workers=4)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=False,
                             collate_fn=collate_pla, num_workers=4)

    print(f"Train: {len(train_ds)}, Valid: {len(valid_ds)}, Test ({args.test_set}): {len(test_ds)}")

    # Model
    model = AffinityModel(
        lig_dim=LIGAND_ATOM_DIM,
        poc_dim=POCKET_ATOM_DIM,
        intra_edge_dim=INTRA_EDGE_DIM,
        inter_edge_dim=INTER_EDGE_DIM,
    ).to(device)
    print(f"Model parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")

    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=args.lr, weight_decay=1e-6)

    # Training with early stopping
    best_val_rmse = float('inf')
    best_epoch = 0
    patience_counter = 0

    for epoch in range(1, args.epochs + 1):
        train_loss = train_epoch(model, train_loader, optimizer, device)
        val_rmse, val_rp = evaluate(model, valid_loader, device)

        print(f"TRAIN_METRICS epoch={epoch} loss={train_loss:.6f} val_rmse={val_rmse:.4f} val_rp={val_rp:.4f}")

        if val_rmse < best_val_rmse:
            best_val_rmse = val_rmse
            best_epoch = epoch
            patience_counter = 0
            os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), os.path.join(args.output_dir, 'best_model.pt'))
        else:
            patience_counter += 1
            if patience_counter >= args.patience:
                print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch}. Best epoch: {best_epoch}")
                break

    # Load best model and evaluate on test set
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(os.path.join(args.output_dir, 'best_model.pt'), weights_only=True))
    test_rmse, test_rp = evaluate(model, test_loader, device)
    print(f"TEST_METRICS rmse={test_rmse:.6f} rp={test_rp:.6f}")
    print(f"Best val RMSE: {best_val_rmse:.4f} at epoch {best_epoch}")

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction")
